limits: All successful processes preserve every frozen non-timing output, including allocations, samples, work accounting and checksums. Only elapsed_ns is excluded from equality.
Each complete fixture contains nine alternating-order pairs. Any increase above five percent requires the frozen follow-up rule; partial fixtures remain partial.
An original process failure is not passed by a separate larger-cap diagnostic. A missing final receipt does not identify the interrupted internal stage.

The proof-only extraction provides no new completeness gain to justify a runtime regression. The fixed pre-Verus acceptance baseline, earlier cost failures/tradeoff and main/full-board admission remain separate open obligations.
